description: A single static-source vulnerability finding produced by aratame under an active InspectionMandate. nonAdjudicating + defensiveContextOnly are structural consts: a finding is EVIDENCE / an accountability+resilience map for the owner (G8), NOT a verdict and NOT an exploitation target-list, and carries NO PoC/exploit content (G9 / Charter Rider §2(a)). This record is the tsukuroi-compatible finding source: tsukuroi.finding_intake (ADR-2605291500) may consume a vulnFinding cid under a RemediationMandate referencing the same owner+repo, alongside akuma's runtime VulnFinding. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field + Charter Rider scan gate.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of finding emit.

repoRef.description: repoUrl@ref the finding was observed in (mirrors the mandate).

category.description: Source of the finding: static analysis / dependency CVE / leaked secret.

severity.description: Normalized severity (triage_synthesis normalizes across tools; non-adjudicating estimate).

ruleId.description: Scanner rule / check id (e.g. semgrep rule id, CWE id, gitleaks rule).

location.description: file:line (or file path) where the finding was observed. Static location only.

detailCid.description: CID of the full finding payload (ciphertext in vault; metadata here).

dependencyFindingCid.description: For category=Dependency: CID of the com.etzhayyim.aratame.dependencyFinding.

secretFindingCid.description: For category=Secret: CID of the com.etzhayyim.aratame.secretFinding (secret value is NEVER inlined; see G7).

nonAdjudicating.description: G8: structurally true. The finding is evidence / an accountability+resilience map, NOT a verdict and NOT an exploitation target-list.

defensiveContextOnly.description: G9: structurally true. Describes a weakness defensively; carries NO PoC/exploit/offensive payload even as a test fixture (Charter Rider §2(a)).

charterRiderScanPass.description: G1/G9: Charter Rider §2(a)..(h) + offensive/PoC scan PASS (etzhayyim_organism.sensors.charter_rider.scan).

inferenceProvenance.description: G10: if triage was LLM-assisted, records Murakumo judah LiteLLM provenance (model gemma4-26b-a4b); no vendor API.
